newsitem.title: DUBAI: Force 4.2 quake jolts eastern Iran.
newsitem.headline: Force 4.2 quake jolts eastern Iran.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.2 on the Richter scale jolted the cities of Birjand and Qaen in eastern Iran on Monday, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported.

It said the seismological centre of the Geophysics Institute affiliated to Tehran University put the time of the earthquake at 02:56 (2226 GMT Sunday) and registered the epicentre 800 km southeast of the centre.
The agency said there had been no report of any damage.
A 7.1 magnitude earthquake hit Birjand and Qaen, in Khorasan province, in May killing more than 1,500 people and causing massive damage.
